# M3.1 actual ATM10 integrated-server playtest

**The startup recipe-recovery hotfix passed in the actual ATM10 client.** The lead agent performed the explicitly authorized restart, JAR installation, world opening and command checks. The research/verification agent independently checked only the relevant new-session log entries and installed JAR identity. No `/reload` was used to obtain recovery.

This report contains bounded technical observations only. It includes no player/account identifier, world name, position, screenshot, raw inventory export, quest-book export or unrelated chat. Log line references describe the file at inspection and may change after rotation.

## Observed recovery sequence

All times below are host-local on 22 September 2026. Evidence comes from the new session's `logs/latest.log`.

| Time / line reference | Observation |
| --- | --- |
| 22:39:13, lines 2–3 | The launcher reports the JVM and platform above. |
| Loaded-mod list, line 706 | ATM Companion 0.3.1 is present. |
| 22:40:38.627, line 1887 | Companion initializes. |
| 22:44:34.830, line 21812 | The initial manager reports 95,298 loaded recipes. |
| 22:44:44.180, line 22459 | The integrated Minecraft server starts. |
| 22:45:42.641–22:45:44.408, lines 22620–22668 | The actual Ars Unification processors run; completion reports 1.939 seconds. |
| 22:49:08.046, line 26102 | Companion invalidates generation 1 after a **definition-table replacement, 95,473 to 97,050 definitions**, and enters stabilization rather than permanent failure. |
| 22:49:12.104, line 26103 | After 20 unchanged server ticks, Companion automatically begins generation 2, attempt 1 of 8. |
| 22:50:39.391–22:50:39.393, lines 26285–26286 | The bounded index finishes and generation 2 is published. |
| 22:51:26.286–22:51:26.300, lines 26306–26308 | `/companion knowledge` displays the published generation and matching metrics. |

The difference between the initially loaded count and the captured generation-1 count reflects additional runtime definitions. This report does not attribute every added recipe to a particular mod. The actual Ars processing followed by source replacement, automatic restart and successful publication verifies the formerly failing real startup path, beyond the smaller harness reproduction.

## Index coverage and measured performance

| Metric | Observed generation 2 value |
| --- | --- |
| Source definitions | 97,050 |
| Retained indexed definitions | 50,000 |
| Output item IDs indexed | 39,992 |
| Unknown/nonfixed outputs | 4,499 |
| Unsupported dependency models | 14,662 |
| Retained ingredient alternatives / identities | 200,000 / 400,000 |
| Index slices | 1,135 |
| Cumulative active slice time | 4,963 ms |
| Generation-2 elapsed build time | 87,286 ms |
| Longest measured slice | 204 ms |
| Complete coverage | **False**, explicitly reported |

Partial coverage is expected at these configured retention limits; successful publication does not mean every ATM10 recipe or dependency is supported. The five-millisecond slice target is cooperative. The observed 204-millisecond maximum demonstrates that it is not a hard latency ceiling. The log does not identify how much of that slice was recipe work, scheduling delay or other runtime overhead, so no cause is invented here. This playtest did not measure frame rate, a tick-time distribution, or per-command execution duration.

## Requested command results

At **22:52:23**, `/companion goal minecraft:diamond_pickaxe` returned:

- Material status `already_owned` for the requested quantity of one.
- No missing requirement leaves.
- Execution status `not_needed` and next action `complete`.
- An explanation that the requested quantity was present in the inspected main inventory.
- Depth 0, expanded nodes 0, alternatives 0 and unsupported steps 0, while retaining the index-partial notice.

At **22:53:05** and again at **22:53:52**, `/companion next` returned the same completed goal and ownership explanation. The corresponding log entries are lines 26316–26331; no raw inventory listing is included in this report.

Both next-command calls also reported **quest visibility unavailable because FTB observation exceeded the cooperative 250 ms collection budget**. This is an actual limitation encountered in the full pack, not an assertion that no quests exist or that none are available. Goal completion remained usable despite that optional observation being unavailable.

## Verdict and remaining limits

**Verified:** the installed 0.3.1 artifact loaded in the actual graphical client; a real integrated-world startup encountered a late recipe-table change; Companion recovered automatically without `/reload`; knowledge became available; the requested goal and next commands completed without the old index failure.

**Not established by these command checks:** a nontrivial recipe/dependency search, a useful acquisition route, crafting or furnace execution advice, changed-inventory replanning, a complete quest snapshot, dedicated multiplayer login, or successful behavior for every modded recipe. The selected goal was already owned, so it correctly used the ownership shortcut rather than traversing a crafting graph. No item was crafted or machine operated by these checks.

The focused log search found **no Companion indexing, scheduling, recipe-query or planning failure entry through the stated cutoff**. The two explicit quest-budget unavailability results remain recorded above. This is not a claim that the entire modpack log is warning-free or error-free.

The earlier [independent review](../M3.1-ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW.md) and [hotfix verification](../VERIFICATION.md) document the automated gates. This subsequent report adds actual-client evidence for the startup repair while preserving the remaining planning, coverage, performance and quest-observation limits.
